subject: Re: Fix async kernel: shared memory sizing + grid dimensioning (now complete)
body:
Per original task task-1777160635247-003, Kernel has now implemented the missing double-buffer shared memory staging in matrix_tensor_async.cu and verified correctness.

Changes:
- Double-buffer shared memory layout: each warp gets 2× tile buffers (A and B) totaling 1024 halfs (2048 bytes), total shmem 8192 for 4-warp block.
- Updated run_async() to compute shmemBytes accordingly (was 0).
- Added #include <cuda_fp16.h> for __floats2half2_rn intrinsics.
- Removed unused pipeline_shared_state and associated variables.
- Build verified (nvcc sm_120), compute-sanitizer memcheck: 0 errors, 0 leaks.

Grid-dimension Y issue (M=0 root cause) was previously fixed via input validation in main().

Evidence:
- kernels/src/matrix_tensor_async.cu (shared memory extern, staging loops, shmemBytes calc)
- profiles/headless/compute-sanitizer-doublebuffer.txt
- Convergence gate below.

All deliverables for this task are now complete.

convergence_gate.claim: matrix_tensor_async double-buffer shared memory allocation implemented and validated; grid-dim input validation in place; compute-sanitizer memcheck clean; build successful on RTX 5060
